data_fields.name: spectator_delay_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 to 3600 s, set per round in the form

best_idea: Show spectators a fight only as it stood a fixed time ago, read from the one record by time (not from a second copy), with the start position shown until the first delayed time, so a spectator with a wager cannot act on what is still live.
decision_why: A delayed read protects spectator wagers and fits the replay row, but Frankendom's one-ledger ruling rules out the donor's second PGN-style snapshot table, so the delayed view must be a time query on the single fight record.
acceptance: A Pit bout test with a 30 s spectator delay asserts that a view requested at 10 s shows the start state (no hits), a view at 45 s shows events up to 15 s, and the record holds one copy of each event.
